claim: Same-charge uu->TT production of a charge-2/3 VLQ coupled only to first-generation quarks (T->Wd/Zu/Hu) has no dedicated CMS/ATLAS search and should be a new HL-LHC analysis.
surviving_gap: Only a dedicated same-sign-dilepton + 2 light jets (+MET) search with reconstructed m(W j)/m(Z j) peaks and large-width (Gamma/m >~ 1-50%) signal templates survives; it is a niche corner because generic searches/measurements already exclude most of the first-generation kappa-M plane up to kappa~0.07, APV bounds the same couplings, and the only HL-LHC projection (2212.01514) gains only a sliver over APV (g* in [0.056,0.074], M_T 1.5-2.5 TeV). Status: indirectly-covered / constrained-but-region-open.

kill_evidence.what: Contur reinterpretation of published LHC measurements: 'the majority of the first-generation kappa-M_Q plane is excluded at 95% CL ... despite the lack of dedicated searches'; allowed region extends to kappa~0.07 at high mass, similar to APV limits. Includes t-channel weak VLQ pair production (Fig. 1e), i.e. the same-charge process.

The seminal paper itself recasts ATLAS/CMS generic searches (ATLAS 0L squark/gluino 2010.14293, CMS jets+MET 1908.04722, CMS multilepton 1911.04968, CMS 3-jet resonances 1810.10092): same-charge TT excluded up to ~3.5-4 TeV for large widths; bound from same-charge TT is 'largely subdominant with respect to the APV bound on the mixing angle' except low-mass singlet; ATLAS 2405.19862 has 'much higher reach' in the Wd case and 'the same-charge process would also be effectively tested by this search'.
kill_evidence.location: Sec. 3 (Fig. 3, Fig. 5 and text after Eq. APV), Sec. 4.1

kill_evidence.what: HL-LHC (3000 fb-1) projection of exactly this signature (pp->TT via t-channel first-generation coupling, T->Wq, same-sign dileptons + 2 jets + MET) already exists; HL-LHC reach only 'slightly better than the noncollider limits from atomic parity violation'.

hl_projection_docs: arXiv:2212.01514 (pheno HL-LHC projection, same-sign dilepton channel, 3000 fb-1). No CMS/ATLAS Phase-2 projection for this channel found.
showstoppers: Couplings that drive same-charge production (kappa^4) are bounded by atomic parity violation (kappa<~0.07 first generation; 2006.07172 Sec.5, 2504.05476 Sec.3); single production (kappa^2) and QCD pair production generally dominate sensitivity; physics case relies on large-width region which is in tension with APV for singlet/doublet embeddings (2504.05476 Fig. 5). Backgrounds (ssWW, WZ, charge-flip, fakes) manageable but signal rate small for APV-allowed couplings.

claim: Bundle: (a) top-partner/VLQ 'portal matter' decaying to t + dark photon (boosted prompt A'->ll lepton-jet or long-lived A' decaying in the detector) has no CMS/ATLAS search; (b) vector-like leptons in long-lived, tau-rich, triplet/exotic-charge or dark/ALP decay modes are under-searched.
surviving_gap: Part (a) only: a dedicated CMS/ATLAS search for pair (or single) produced T -> t + gamma_d with gamma_d reconstructed as a boosted (prompt or displaced, mm-m) lepton-jet/collimated ll, i.e. 'top + lepton-jet' or 'top + displaced lepton-jet' at HL-LHC. No experimental search found; the phenomenology (including the displaced regime) already exists (1904.05893 Sec. 5-6/Fig. 10, 2112.08425, 2209.13888, 2410.06925), so novelty is experimental-analysis only (proposed-not-searched). The fully-invisible (escaping A') regime is indirectly covered by tt+MET/t+MET recasts. Part (b) DIES: VLL tau/third-generation, LLP-in-muon-system, triplet (type-III seesaw) and inclusive multilepton searches all exist; only doubly-charged VLL prompt decays remain without a found dedicated search (low priority, UNVERIFIED gap).

hl_projection_docs: arXiv:2209.13888 (pheno, 14 TeV 3000 fb-1); arXiv:2112.08425 (pheno LHC). No CMS/ATLAS Phase-2 projection for T -> t gamma_d found.
showstoppers: Boosted GeV-scale A' gives collimated leptons failing standard isolation (needs dedicated lepton-jet reconstruction, as in ATLAS LJ searches - feasible). BR(T->t gamma_d) is model-dependent (dominates only for small m_gamma_d << m_Z and suitable v_d, sin theta). Kinetic mixing epsilon constrained by beam-dump/B-factory; for displaced regime epsilon ~1e-6-1e-4 (1904.05893). Pair-production rate falls fast above ~1.5-2 TeV, so HL-LHC reach is driven by QCD pair rate; existing VLQ limits in standard modes do not apply when BR(T->t gamma_d) ~ 1.

claim: Colour-sextet fermionic top partners (hyperbaryons of fundamental composite Higgs models) have no dedicated CMS/ATLAS search; a dedicated HL-LHC search (pair: multi-top/multi-b/MET; single: Q6 t / Q6 b) is warranted.
surviving_gap: (i) A dedicated search for compressed Q6 -> pi6 Q1hat -> bb + MET spectra (soft b-jets) where generic SUSY recasts lose sensitivity; (ii) a dedicated >=5-6 top / 4t+X high-HT signature from Q6Q6 -> (t S pi8)(t S pi8) at m6 ~ 2.5-3 TeV; (iii) single sextet production (Q6 t, Q6 b via chromomagnetic operator) at HL-LHC - no pheno study yet (theory-explored-untested only for pair). The bulk of pair-production parameter space is indirectly-covered by generic SUSY searches (excluded to ~2.4-2.6 TeV full multiplet), with HL-LHC extrapolated recast reach ~2.75-3 TeV, leaving only a few hundred GeV of mass reach for a dedicated analysis.

kill_evidence.what: Seminal paper's own recast of ATLAS-SUSY-2018-31, ATLAS-SUSY-2018-17, CMS-SUS-19-006: full sextet multiplet excluded up to 2.42 (2.64) TeV LO (K=3); pi6 channel 2.65 (2.9) TeV; HL-LHC extrapolation (3 ab-1, 13 TeV) ~2.75 TeV LO, ~3 TeV with K=3. 'existing analyses already have sensitivity to a substantial fraction of the multi-TeV mass range'.
Compressed bb+MET regime explicitly identified as where recasts lose sensitivity -> surviving gap

hl_projection_docs: arXiv:2605.04143 Sec. 4 & App. B (luminosity extrapolation of recasts to 3 ab-1 at 13 TeV); arXiv:2609.19918 (proceedings summary, recast bound up to 2.64 TeV). No CMS/ATLAS Phase-2 projection for coloured sextet fermions found.
showstoppers: (1) MC: public shower tools do not support the 3x6x8 colour flow; 2605.04143 uses an unvalidated triplet surrogate - a dedicated experimental analysis needs proper signal modelling. (2) No NLO cross section (K-factor of 3 is a guess) -> large theory uncertainty on mass limits. (3) Model dependence on pNGB masses (pi8 fixed at 1.5 TeV, constrained >~1.375 TeV) and on spectrum (m1, m6). (4) Small marginal gain: rate-limited at ~3 TeV, recasts already near HL reach. (5) Single production is loop/model-coupling suppressed.

claim: Bundle: (1) Drell-Yan angular coefficients A0-A2 (Lam-Tung violation) and (2) naive-T-odd A5-A7 have only been measured at the Z peak, so a high-m_ll/high-pT unfolded A_i measurement is a gap; (3) high-mass A_FB / running of sin2theta_W above the Z pole has not been probed.
surviving_gap: (1) A full (phi-dependent) unfolded A0-A7 measurement, in particular A2 and A0-A2, double-differential in m_ll (>~170-200 GeV) and pT_ll - not done by CMS/ATLAS (A0 alone vs mass, pT/y-integrated, template-level, exists in CMS 2202.12327). (2) A5-A7 above the Z peak: no measurement found (survives, but SM ~0 and statistics at high m & high pT are small). (3) A_FB at high mass is ALREADY MEASURED (CMS 2202.12327, m>170 GeV up to >1 TeV, 138 fb-1) and used in SMEFT fits -> that part DIES; only an experimental extraction of MSbar sin2theta_W(mu) running from high-mass NC DY survives (no CMS/ATLAS result found; theory HL-LHC projections exist in 2302.10782).

kill_evidence.what: CMS 13 TeV, 138 fb-1: A_FB measured vs dilepton mass for m>170 GeV (bins 170,200,250,320,510,700,1000,inf), mumu and ee, AND A0 measured vs mass in the same high-mass region; used to set Z' limits. Directly contradicts the seed statement that existing angular measurements are Z-peak only.

showstoppers: Chirality-breaking ops enter A0-A2 only quadratically (1/Lambda^4), and A5-A7 effects come from dim-8 or dipole x dipole: expected effects are small relative to systematic uncertainties of phi-dependent acceptance corrections at high mass. A2/A5-A7 need finite pT_ll; the high-m_ll x high-pT_ll corner has limited statistics even at 3 ab-1 (number not checked, UNVERIFIED). Running of sin2theta at high mass is degenerate with PDFs and with SMEFT four-fermion operators (2310.19638 discussion) - interpretive, not detector, challenge.
